items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: We played all the famous marches, quite a bit of Susan's marches.

ctx.x: What was the music like when you, the first music you remember hearing the band play? Did they play those popular pieces in charge of jazzy and time? That's right. Kind of jazzy time.

Ragtime. Ragtime back in those days, you know. Even when you were a boy. We played all the famous marches, quite a bit of Susan's marches. Yes. All heavy marches, you know. The kick that we got out of playing those kind of things, when they bring those bands from St. Louis, Chicago, down in the for Carnival, you know, we used to Carnival marches out of the government street. Yes. And we'd meet the little 14th piece band and put them out of commission, you know. Used to blast away, you know. They'd have probably…
Why did they stop doing funerals? Do you know why they stopped doing funerals?
